programmes.d: Sabrina’s baseball team is on a major losing streak. And Gem is there to point it out.
When it seems like Hilda isn’t going to pass a test for her mortal driver’s license, Sabrina conjures up a cute driving instructor to help & inspire her.

Will competes in the Free-Diving Championships but afterward chooses to break from the sport and shrug off Sophie's influence on his life. Rikki sees Sophie kissing Zane at the event and breaks off their relationship.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Queen for a Day
programmes.d: Zane installs Sophie as head of staff at the café. Bella develops a sneezing allergy that also accidentally triggers her powers. Sophie seizes on the problem and looks to fire Bella and the band.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Jewel Thief
programmes.d: The girls discover the Mako crystals contain immense energy and need to mount a rescue mission when Zane jealously steals one in an effort to gain Rikki's attention.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mako Masters
programmes.d: The girls sit their final school exams and have to avoid a water attack in public when the full moon rises early. They confront the water force in the Moon Pool and are given a message about Mako Island.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Beach Party
programmes.d: Bella's eager to ask Will to the end of year party until she sees him asking Rikki. A big misunderstanding occurs, which prompts Will to express his true feelings for Bella. Sophie tries to get Zane to change the name of the café.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Too Close for Comfort
programmes.d: Don gets a second job at the Marine Park on the Pirate ship and outshines Cleo, threatening the future of her Dolphin show. Bella and Will find difficulty trying to connect with each others' interests.

UBOS is acting weird and dizzy as the kids learn he's becoming UNGLUED, literally! The Book is losing its binding and can only be rebound by the magical BOOKBINDING GNOMES who've been captured by Zarlak and taken deep into the Centre of the Earth.

Like other ancient families with a long and honorable past, KAZZ's family has a coat-of-arms. But on Gez Day, honoring KAZZ's famous relative, jealous Lucrezia and Borge get back at Kazz who is being egotistical and judgmental.

Kasimir and Gus get into a competition over who will be first to get a date for the upcoming school dance. Kasimir meets a cute boy in a magic-novelty shop and secretly uses REAL magic to impress him.

Cassy gets an identity crisis when, in Shapeshifting 101, she's the kid who can't change shape. But there's no time to worry about it because the kids encounter a bottled IMP from the Centre of The Earth.
Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.
Cleo is failing at school and is assigned a tutor - Charlotte. Cleo wants Lewis back but her attitude to Charlotte only drives him further away. Cleo discovers Lewis and Charlotte kissing.
Zane hears of a treasure under the ocean and enlists the girls to find it. Rikki is injured in the search. Zane gives Rikki the reward. Charlotte contrives to keep Lewis from the girls.
Emma starts acting weird after pricking her finger on a barb of coral. Cleo’s fish Hector exhibits the same behaviour. Emma becomes more and more like a fish and Lewis has to find a way to cure her.

Don takes the family camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. The girls are affected and need the moon pool for sanctuary. Charlotte almost slips in the moon pool and realises something weird is going on there.

Emma thinks she’s going to get a promotion at the juice bar but Ash is given the job. Emma and Ash clash over the job, but we discover it’s over a lot more. Meanwhile, Lewis stands up to Charlotte over spending time with Cleo.
Marshall is love's reluctant mail carrier when the ghost of a 1920s smitten teen demands that Marshall delivers a love letter to the spirit's dreamgirl, now an elderly woman.
Marshall needs to be saved from daylight savings (which isn't in effect in Eerie) after he resets his time and falls into a dimension always one hour behind.
Best friends Camille and Mildred are obsessed with monsters and vampires.
Lowly Walter would like nothing more than to join Ken "kingpin" Seldon's secret club.
Naomi is extremely self-conscious about her height. That, plus the fact that shes the only girl on her class field trip to the Egyptian Pyramids.

Petey and the rest of the guys are looking forward to a week of summer R and R at Camp Rockbotom until flat-topped Counsellor Bill call them to attention and informs them that there will be no time for fun.

Cyril inherits an Irish castle, where water from the Well of Doon is said to cure all ailments. To preserve the well for the inhabitants of the city, Cyril has to fight against an inheritance claim of rich businessman, Ron Blackard.
When a disgruntled employee steals an ancient Dragon Flute from a Toronto Museum, he uses its legendary powers to render crowds of people unconscious.
When a lucky coin is stolen from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, it triggers a market crash, threatening even the vast wealth of the Ripley fortune.
When Sam's friend, Suzi Moto, is charged with burning down her New York fashion show, all evidence points to her purchase of a kimono Rip believes is cursed.
An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle...
Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic...
Tsubasa is almost defeated by Ryuga in an intense battle until Phoenix comes to the rescue; Gingka fights Tobio in a stadium of moving walls.
When a gang led by Busujima takes over their stadium, Kenta and Sora have to battle hard to get it back.
Gingka is in a panic to win back enough points to enter Battle Bladers, he gives up a final challenge match to help his friends win against Tsubasa.
Gingka wins against Phoenix, leading Phoenix to return his pointer to him with enough points to enter Battle Bladers.

Jason and his friends try to keep the Cyber-Link from falling into the hands of a notorious underworld arms dealer.
An evil poacher kidnaps Lua to use as bait for his real target, Kong.
Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray. But when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.
Sonic and Tails infiltrate Robotnik's new Casino Night Zone to stop him and his henchmen from scamming a group of sheep into becoming Robotnik's slaves.
Betty begins to mysteriously receive fortune cookies that instruct her to carry out simple good deeds each of which leads to a reward.
When a sunken treasure is found off the coast of Riverdale, Reggie succumbs to the greedy curse of the pirate's gold.
Spooky and mysterious things are happening at Riverdale High.
Dr. Arachnid, an evil supervillain, has come to Riverdale to commit some dastardly deeds.

'Erik The Pink' in Viking times, the Panther's only hope for a vacation is to pose as Erik the Red and set sail with a crew of plunderers. 'Pretty and Pink': In Elizabethan England, Pinky must dress up as the queen to thwart an evil jewel thief.

'Built For Speed': When Pinky and Rex Barklay vie for car salesmen of the month, Pinky discovers his rival is stealing new cars. 'The Pooch and the Panther': Dog groomer Pinky tries to resuscitate a canine who appears to have bought the big burrito.

'Pinky in Toyland': Witness to a bank heist, the Panther evades robbers by masquerading as a stuffed animal. 'The Detective of Oz': Pinky works as a hard-boiled detective in the Emerald City helping a dame named Dorothy find her stolen ruby pumps.

'Royal Canadian Mounted Panther': Pinky dreams of being a Mounty and gets his chance when a 'Damsel in Distress' mistakes him for one. 'Power of Pink': Through an experiment, the Panther is changed from a mild mannered plumber into Super Pink.
Stiles recommends The Wolf Pack to entertain at the Wolverton Festival. However, this bike gang brings big trouble, and Scott must find a way to scare them out of town.

Scott and his family make a trip to Rottenberg, Transylvania in order to reconnect with their past. However, danger lurks when the townspeople seem very spooked by the castle that the family inherited.

Mr. Bean discovers the great outdoors is not always so great. An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about his lovely summers at scout camp as a boy and sets him planning a night under the stars with Teddy.
Mr. Bean’s hobby goes down in flames in his battle for air supremacy. When his model aeroplane is blown out of the sky by that of a rival kid, Mr. Bean sets his sights on revenge.

During a visit to Buckingham Palace, Mr. Bean meets the lady of the house. When Mr. Bean breaks his favourite Royal mug he discovers there's only one place to buy a replacement: Buckingham Palace, home of the Queen of England

Mr. Bean takes a trip down Memory Lane. When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride?
Enchantra comes to town for her Annual Witch Evaluation test.
